name: fix91_creature_melee
verifies: fix-91 #2: a creature's bite lands only from its jaw (G3: the animal's own body touches the victim's group-7 trigger; jaw up to 1.1-1.6 m ahead of its root + the hero's 0.64 m trigger), not from the AI's attack range (wolf 2.9 m, boar 3.0 m, scavenger 2.35 m + the strike capsule + the trigger = 3.4-3.9 m before). The hero, standing still, is bitten only when the animal has stepped into jaw range; he can trade blows with a wolf, a scavenger and a boar, and his hits during their wind-up make them stumble (non-humanoid -> Stumble).
steps: log -- wolf: bites reach the hero only from close
spawn Wolf attitude=hostile dist=6 side=front as=w
log wolf bites in 10 s: see touches, the combat log line 'HIT on the hero by' gives the distance
spawn Scavenger attitude=hostile dist=5 side=front as=s
spawn Boar attitude=hostile dist=6 side=front as=b
notes: god mode refills the hero; each fight line gives swings vs touched (should be most swings) and the time spent in hit reactions. LogLunges is on in fight: a creature bite that did not reach logs '[CombatFighter] ... closest gap'. Compare with the same scenario on main (1c0a601): bites from 3+ m, few hero touches.
